entries.test_name: retro CLI preserves raw proposals without grading metadata and refreshes measured costs
entries.explanation: Five attempts contain three positive measured costs totaling 4.5, two unknown costs and six metadata-only cases. The real rendered line includes retry pending 2 and advice graded 0.

entries.test_name: retro CLI publishes an empty report without inventing agreement or cost
entries.explanation: The exact empty summary omitted the added advice_graded, advice_agree, advice_disagree and retry_pending fields. All four must be zero; existing assertions still require no invented cost/agreement, no rows and unchanged Brain.

entries.test_name: retro CLI refreshes late abstention costs after its outcome leaves the Brain
entries.explanation: Initial positive costs are two totaling 4. A late zero receipt stays unknown; a late 3 receipt raises the count to three totaling 7. Deleted outcomes and role identities remain unchanged and abstention never enters binary agreement.

entries.test_name: retro CLI refreshes late invalid-response costs without grading or redispatch
entries.explanation: A zero ccusage receipt is incomplete, so the paid invalid attempt stays unmeasured. Positive complete receipts count, ledger and missing receipts do not. All role identities, parser errors, agreement denominators and Brain bytes are still checked.

entries.test_name: retro CLI removes stale comparisons until durability is judged again
entries.explanation: The durability detection boundary, withdrawn and restored comparisons and unchanged Brain checks remain active. Cost accounting uses the three positive receipts totaling 4.5, average 1.5 rather than including the zero receipt.

entries.test_name: retro CLI reuses saved cases when later durability and costs arrive
entries.explanation: Late 0.75 receipt raises measured costs to four totaling 5.25, with one zero-dollar unknown and average 1.3125. Report/Brain identity, repeat-refresh and changed-truth checks remain active.

entries.test_name: retro CLI withdraws stale costs without changing the comparison cohort
entries.explanation: After two positive receipts are withdrawn, only the 0.5 abstention is measured. Its withdrawal leaves no measured cost; the zero receipt cannot preserve a measured denominator. Restoring positive receipts recovers three costs totaling 4.5 without redispatch or cohort changes.

entries.test_name: retro bounded batches count paid abstentions and invalid responses outside agreement rates
entries.explanation: Four paid attempts contain three positive measured costs totaling 4.75 and one zero-dollar unknown; average is 4.75/3, unmeasured 1, retry pending 2 and no accepted/advice grading.
